tools.description: Documentation on Tempo configuration. Best for questions about how to configure or operate Tempo. Request the overview to learn which configuration block does what, or the reference for the complete list of options and their defaults.

name.description: The type of Tempo configuration documentation to retrieve

tools.name: docs-config

tools.description: Documentation on TraceQL search. Best for retrieval of traces. This covers basic attributes all the way through aggregates, pipelining, structural queries, and more. Includes examples.

name.description: The type of TraceQL documentation to retrieve

tools.name: docs-traceql

tools.description: Get a list of available attribute names that can be used in TraceQL queries. This is useful for finding the names of attributes that can be used in a query.

scope.description: Optional scope to filter attributes by (span, resource, event, link, instrumentation). If not provided, returns all attributes.

tools.name: get-attribute-names

tools.description: Get a list of values for a fully scoped attribute name. This is useful for finding the values of a specific attribute. i.e. you can find all the services in the data by asking for resource.service.name

filter-query.description: Filter query to apply to the attribute values. It can only have one spanset and only \u0026\u0026'ed conditions like { \u003ccond\u003e \u0026\u0026 \u003ccond\u003e \u0026\u0026 ... }.This is useful for filtering the values to a specific set of values. i.e. you can find all endpoints for a given service by asking for span.http.endpoint and filtering resource.service.name.

name.description: The attribute name to get values for (e.g. 'span.http.method', 'resource.service.name')

tools.name: get-attribute-values

tools.description: Retrieve a specific trace by ID
tools.name: get-trace

tools.description: Retrieve a single metric value given a TraceQL metrics query. The value is at the current instant or end. Most metrics questions can be answered with instant values.

end.description: End time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be after start.

start.description: Start time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be before end.

tools.name: traceql-metrics-instant

tools.description: Retrieve a metric series given a TraceQL metrics query. The series ranges from start to end.

end.description: End time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be after start.

start.description: Start time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be before end.

tools.name: traceql-metrics-range

end.description: End time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be after start.

start.description: Start time for the search (RFC3339 format). If not provided will search the past 1 hour. If provided, must be before end.

tools.name: traceql-search
